gap_plan.eta: 训练队列完成数见下表；参考终档补齐和安全验收时间以产物为准。

gap_plan.name: 异构多约束（硬 + 软）上的 SOTA
gap_plan.gap: 已有候选改善，SOTA 完整复核仍待完成。PG2 筛选点 15.5 @ 1.6% 观测硬违规率；CG2 低违规侧筛选点 8.6 @ 0.3%。观测均值达标不等于逐种子风险上界达标。
gap_plan.cause: 雷达边距阈值是单一旋钮：阈值紧则泄漏低但回报掉，阈值松则相反；固定阈值拿不到两头。执行筛选后的改善仍须与随机动作对照区分；g 的校准误差及无可行候选时的回退可能限制安全效果，因果解释尚待复验。
gap_plan.remedy: （a）边距日程（0.95 起、前 0.5–1.5M 步线性收紧到目标阈值）：56 个 run，已完成 50；（b）执行时可行性筛选：从策略分布采 K=16 个候选动作，在 g≤pf 的集合内选最高 q；集合为空时选最低 g（同权重、不重训、随机采样对照组用于排除随机性）；已有增补种子与评测继续按产物收集；后加块保留为探索性数据，不能承诺加块后达标。PG2 m0.83 日程候选已冻结新评测块，与无筛选/随机动作配对复验；未分型 FDPI 的同筛选对照仍需完整收齐。
gap_plan.eta: PG2 冻结复验已完成；CG2 按逐训练种子的奖励、硬风险上界与软预算共同验收，探索队列进度不等于通过。
gap_plan.evidence: CG2 lp 19.0 @ 3.7% (n=5) vs SDAC 7.9 @ 42.0%；PG2 m0.85 13.1 @ 2.7% (n=5) vs SRCPO 5.0 @ 35.0%；执行筛选 CG2 m0.8sched1500k_r2+K16 pf0.02：回报 16.74，硬事件 9/936（观测 0.96%），最差种子名义 CP95 2.91%，三/多种子同时上界 3.44%，软预算满足 1/3；配置搜索后的探索性证据；PG2 m0.83sched_r2+K16 pf0.02：回报 10.57，硬事件 1/936（观测 0.11%），最差种子名义 CP95 1.51%，三/多种子同时上界 1.92%，软预算满足 3/3；配置搜索后的探索性证据；PG2固定三个策略的新块复验：平均回报 10.49，硬事件 13/1872，组内同时硬风险上界最差 1.96%，软预算满足 3/3；原定门槛通过。

gap_plan.name: SafeVLA 范式内的安全学习（价格换源 vs PPO-Lag）
gap_plan.gap: 尚无完成的两臂匹配终档评测。seed 1 当前状态：失败 / 失败；归档模型与当前尝试分别记录。当前仍是单聚合约束 pilot。
gap_plan.cause: 09-09 核验到主机重启及旧脚本恢复训练；旧检查点缺失安全乘子/图状态，恢复会重置这部分状态，不能算作未中断的同协议训练。请求的 2 个 minibatch 实际仍为 1。
gap_plan.remedy: 固定 VLA 终档评测 396/400 回合，196/200 配对任务；部分结果不作方法优劣结论。两臂使用相同200任务，严格加载全部模型权重；逐动作完整成本和官方计数同时保留。V2 单独队列比较 SafeVLA、原版 SafeOT、rollout 预算对齐版；真实采样、保存和恢复通过后接续新种子对照，第三臂还须确认预算旋钮实际生效，最多6个正式运行。当前状态见 V2 队列，pilot 不计作正式效果证据。
gap_plan.eta: 按终档评测收集记录推进；seed 1 完成时间待恢复协议就绪后估计。
gap_plan.evidence: 30314：armA_ppolag_s0 2.20M 总步数 [训练完成]（从 1.70M 旧档恢复，安全状态重置）（训练日志近10窗口的集均成本 0.88 / 成功率 0.87）；armA_ppolag_s1 0.11M 总步数 [失败]（训练日志近10窗口的集均成本 2.10 / 成功率 0.90）；armB_sotd_s0 2.20M 总步数 [训练完成]（从 1.70M 旧档恢复，安全状态重置）（训练日志近10窗口的集均成本 1.20 / 成功率 0.93）；armB_sotd_s1 0.00M 总步数 [失败]（从 0.70M 旧档恢复，安全状态重置）；没有完整匹配终档评测。固定 VLA 终档评测 396/400 回合，196/200 配对任务；部分结果不作方法优劣结论。预算说明：发布代码的 beta 将 128 步窗口成本与 2.31 比较；TRAIN cost 是集均成本，两者不能直接判同一预算达标。

gap_plan.gap: 尚不能保证零泄漏。当前证据覆盖训练累计违约、参数曲线，以及部分评测中未观测硬违规的工作点；高回报与逐种子软预算、硬风险上界须同时验收。
gap_plan.cause: 回报上限由环境在给定步数下的 Pareto 前沿决定，价格只能按比例换成本；2M 下所有方法都还在瞬态。
gap_plan.remedy: 10M 表补到 n=5（mainskill）；速度套件 10M（5090）；typed 日程 run + 执行时可行性筛选争取同时满足回报与泄漏目标（筛选宽度 S 是执行时的连续安全旋钮）。论文以「同回报下累计违约最低 + 可调旋钮」为 G5 主张。
gap_plan.eta: 10M 补种 09-09/10；typed 日程 + 筛选 09-09。

fleet.scope: 资源与进程计数；训练进程含并行研究线，不能代替已完成实验或目标验收。
fleet.process_state_semantics: train/eval仅计无停止信号的存活进程组（R/S/D/I）；暂停、部分暂停、僵尸与未知状态单列。活动不代表检查点推进。
fleet.dispatch_policy: 保留运行中的冻结任务；只调度已登记且无重复的任务；不按结果改种子、学习率或安全门槛。

vla_failure_diagnosis.note: Zero completed episodes alone does not establish pre-action failure; the frozen evaluator traceback is also required.

cpo_rebuild.claim: Separate reconstituted baseline cohort; matched comparator review required before endpoint acceptance.

protocol.hypothesis: Approach-gated margin preserves progress around nearby hazards while LP pricing controls soft cost; compare within a single repaired FDPI trainer.
protocol.analysis: Report all12 final policies with paired block/reset comparisons and between-training-seed uncertainty; per-seed empirical soft budgets and hard-event confidence bounds. No posthoc seed or checkpoint selection.
limits: Mechanism development cohort, not automatic SOTA/zero-leak acceptance.
312 episodes per frozen policy cannot certify a0.5%risk threshold at95%even with zero events.
Price mode and gate are the only factorial changes; no training/deployment action filter.
Operational20k runs are excluded from scientific results; failed attempts retained; no retries.
Typed original rewards are shaped before replay; this cohort uses the repaired Dual replay consistently in allarms.

protocol.hypothesis: Test whether approach-only margin improves reward at matched hard-event and soft-budget constraints across LP epsilon strengths, in a second heterogeneous environment.
primary_comparisons: approach minus distance at each matched price setting
each LP epsilon minus fixed0.1 within each gate; show all three epsilon points
protocol.analysis: Report all24 fixed-budget final policies; three training seeds per arm and matched reset blocks; between-seed uncertainty, per-policy hard-risk bounds and soft-budget feasibility. No checkpoint/seed selection. Plot actual complete epsilon curves, without assuming monotonicity.
limits: Separate PG2 CPU cohort; do not pool with CG2 GPU runs or count matched seeds as extra independent replications.
312 episodes per policy cannot certify0.5%risk at95%, even at zero events.
LP --eps varied; FDPI --epsilon remains0.1. No training/deployment action filter.
Eight20k/save-load operational gates excluded from scientific results. Single attempt and bounded wall time for all24 fullruns.
One scenario cannot establish heterogeneous SOTA. No zero-leak guarantee or universal endpoint dominance assumed.

protocol.hypothesis: Measure the reward/safety frontier across three LP-epsilon values in each gate mode, holding the same CG2 trainer and host fixed.
primary_comparisons: all three LP-epsilon points within each gate on the same host
approach minus distance at each epsilon
protocol.analysis: Report all18 fixed-budget final policies and complete epsilon curves; three training seeds per setting, matched reset blocks, seed uncertainty, per-policy hard-risk bounds and soft-budget feasibility. No outcome-based selection. The eps1 arms are explicit same-host controls, not additional independent seeds for the30109cohort.
limits: Separate CG2 CUDA cohort; epsilon1 anchors deliberately repeat settings on this host for within-host comparisons. Do not pool with30109orPG2 runs.

statistical_correction.formula: Zero events: one-sided binomial upper = 1 - alpha**(1/n); fixed independent episode draws conditional on a frozen policy.
statistical_correction.note: 三种子合并936集的区间仅针对合并口径，不能证明每个种子都满足0.5%；零观察事件也不是零风险证明。
